description: Two independent Q12 signed multiplies per beat: lane k multiplies a[12k+:12] by b[12k+:12] (k=0,1; bits 31:24 are don't care), rounds the Q24 product half-up and shifts it right by c[4k+:4], then crops to signed 16-bit. result=the two 16-bit lanes, lane 0 low. aux[7:0]=c[7:0] echoed, aux[8+k]=lane k was cropped, aux[31:9]=0. fault=1 on a cropped lane or on nonzero c[31:8] (malformed control, result=aux=0).
hardware_advantage: A stereo gain stage with per-channel requantisation and saturation reporting: two slices do in one beat what costs a CPU two multiply-high sequences plus two fix-up branches.
provenance: original source authored in this workspace; no third-party RTL imported
qualification: engineering candidate; not certified production or side-channel protection
